single_change: BCE on mean probability across24views, replacing mean per-view BCE. All clip-condition weights are sums of original view weights.
anchor_and_initialization: Original V7 theta, both unchanged from V8 original training
inference: 12 full frames +12hflip, arithmetic mean probabilities, threshold0.5; no forensic
primary: Strict increase in mean of VD and DLC full_frame Macro-F1. This equal-domain research summary is NOT official combined score.
rejection: Any FP/FN increase within each VD/DLC development condition (full_frame/jpeg_75/blur_1)
Any comma original FP increase percondition
Any FP/FN increase in oldval iPhone/TCL or public guard if development passed
guards: Candidate guards only after development pass; baseline guards inventoried. No candidate guard scores if development fails.
reserved: 127/288 DLC reserved frames remain unscored; prior user waiver maintained; no independent confirmation available
runtime: Only if all development+guards pass; fixed head export and actual entry checks with V8. Otherwise no export/inference.
stop: No second candidate, hyperparameter/threshold search, restarts or automated follow-on diagnoses. No submission or model replacement.

candidates_considered.name: clip_probability_bce
candidates_considered.error: Mixed-view errors and near-threshold video means
candidates_considered.difference_from_failed_prior: Training unit alone; no further regularization sweep or new encoder
candidates_considered.cost: Reuse4824x512features; one CPUheadfit; no added inference forward
candidates_considered.risk: Nonconvex objective; easy views can hide weak views; lower loss not proof of better labels

candidates_considered.name: mean_logit_aggregation
candidates_considered.mechanism: Average fixedV8 logits then sigmoid instead of probabilities
candidates_considered.reason_rejected: No evidence extreme logits are more trustworthy; cannot fix every-view wrong clips; weaker error-mechanism evidence
candidates_considered.would_reject: No fullframe gain or any perconditionFP/FN regression

expert_consensus: Design/falsification/evaluation agree on one loss-unit change; agreement is not experimental evidence. Evaluation primary prioritizes full_frame over pooled augmentation.
execution_audit: v8_eval reviewed signed logsumexp loss and gradients,weights,split and gates before execution; no blocking defects
